notes: Adds a business-isolated Weekly Review derived from authoritative History, Action, Execution Kit and Outcome records.
Review content distinguishes recorded facts from summaries and does not infer causal ROI or fabricate activity.
Weekly Review uses a deterministic seven-day window and exposes explicit period boundaries.
Completed Actions report recorded Outcomes when present and explicitly report missing Outcomes when absent.
Execution Kit usage is summarized from recorded asset usage within the review period.
Review remains read-only and does not mutate History or Business Memory automatically.
Mobile integration must use existing PES routing and shell conventions without framework restructuring.
Runtime remains disabled outside development/test; release, deployment and production enablement are not authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner authorized merging VS-09 and starting the next approved slice, VS-10 Weekly Review.
Authorization covers implementation and testing. Certification, merge, release, deployment and production enablement remain separately gated.
